## Inline math

The mass-energy equivalence is \(E = mc^2\), and the same inline form works
with dollar signs: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.

## Display math

$$
\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
$$

\[

\]
